propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model receives ambiguous openai: prefix because v2 will reinterpret it from Chat Completions to Responses.
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target independently compose and return the ambiguous openai: qualifier, triggering the warning at runtime.

ProviderSession gates for custom base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint override match only on the legacy openai provider name, causing endpoint routing failure when targets are normalized to explicit openai-chat:.

Normalizing inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to openai-chat: throughout anthropic_model.py, model_classes.py, and ProviderSession preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics and endpoint behavior.
Documentation examples and provider matrix contracts must updated to recommend openai-chat: and validate that Chat Completions payloads and custom-endpoint compatibility remain unchanged.
